headline.text: L1 tapioca delayed at port until 10/6–10/8, forcing S4 down at *noon today* and wiping Monday's Canada run — kitchen also ran dry twice on caramel overnight.

per_plant_summary.L1: S4 ran out of tapioca mid-shift and will shut down around noon for level 2 clean until 10/5. Kitchen couldn't keep up with S2 jar speed overnight — caramel dropped twice, forcing pauses. S1 enrober return valve stuck during cleaning (workaround in place), S3 caustic drain valve also stuck mid-clean.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 printer fought back all morning — blurry dates forced an 80-minute stop across multiple head cleanings before clearing at 10:51. FFS cross seal jaws caused doubles and product-between-jaws alarms for 18 hours straight; multiple cleaning cycles, last fix at 11:40 cut the issue significantly.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 wrapped overnight level 2 clean at 07:33 after jogging cooling cabinet slats manually to reach chocolate in upper areas. ML1 camera 2 had 133 failures due to chocolate between diffuser and lens — cleaned and back online. Truffle line and MF Matrix ran clean; Matrix produced 47 pallets overnight.

notes.text: Bequet confirmed tapioca arriving 10/6–10/8; Canada single-piece run postponed from Monday.
Maintenance installed metal detector key lock on S1 allowing reject bin access without belt stop.
Jeffrey adjusted FFS weighright max allowable to accommodate 12-piece bags, cutting blowoffs ~80%.
Phillip Perez labeling all Theegarten belts with Felix's layout documentation for clearer communication.

resolved.title: S4 folding arms #2 and #3 bent
resolved.summary: Caramel pieces running 31–33 mm (too long for machine) bent folding arms; product removed from tunnel 2 while cut length adjusted.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:02 — caramel length adjusted, pieces back in spec (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: S3 brookies supply gap
resolved.summary: Line paused at 12:11 when item 21081 ran out; product arrived and line restarted by 12:25.

resolved.title: ML2 twin belts adjustment
resolved.summary: Line down at 12:57 for Justin to adjust twin belts.

resolved.title: ML2 bars breaking after demolder
resolved.summary: Chocolate bars breaking easily post-demolder; cooler temperature adjusted from 48° to 50° to improve temper.
resolved.resolution: Resolved at 18:52 — "I think 50 is perfect" after monitoring, bars looking better (Brandon Lance).

resolved.title: ML2 mold twist breaking bars
resolved.summary: Twisting motion of mold during demolding caused chocolate bars to break; maintenance reduced movement intensity.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 02:45 — "The bar has now improved significantly" after maintenance reduced intensity (Jose Cabrera).

resolved.title: ML2 nozzle plate off-center
resolved.summary: One bar consistently cracking out of cooler; investigation traced to nozzle plate not centered, causing uneven fill weight.
resolved.resolution: Line back up at 06:38 — "Operator adjusted nozzle plate, it was not centered" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: FFS shoulder jam
resolved.summary: Film passed through and line stopped for shoulder jam at flow wrap.
resolved.resolution: Cleared and line running at 11:58 — "Had a shoulder jam. It's been cleared and now reassembling" (Jeffrey Barney).

resolved.title: ML1 camera 2 high failure rate
resolved.summary: Camera 2 had 133 failures with new sensor due to overexposed images; chocolate found between diffuser cover and camera lens.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:23 — removed and cleaned diffuser and lens with damp towel, good image after clean (Leon Brueger).

resolved.title: ML4 90-degree belt missing
resolved.summary: Belt was missing from 90-degree transfer; Shane located and reinstalled it.
resolved.resolution: Reinstalled at 23:23 — belt back in place (Shane Olsen with photo).

resolved.title: ML4 TG5 assembly delay
resolved.summary: Parts cleaned but not reassembled; maintenance was on ML1 and Cavanna changeover and didn't receive radio call.
resolved.resolution: Ready for ATP at 03:15 — maintenance returned and completed assembly (Jose Vasquez).

resolved.title: ML4 cooling cabinet 4 cleaning access
resolved.summary: Upper areas of cooling cabinet 4 still had chocolate, hard to reach without chain moving; team couldn't clean during regular wash.
resolved.resolution: Resolved at 07:33 — Juan manually rotated all cooling cabinet slats with WDS doors closed, team cleaned all areas (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: ML1 temper slope consistently high
resolved.summary: Imperial temper slope reading high; Shawn requested crystallization temp adjustment down 0.2 and recalculation.
resolved.resolution: Adjustment made at 12:19 — operator came down 0.2 on crystallization temp and recalculated (Shawn Jewkes confirmed receipt).

needs_attention.title: Tapioca shortage forcing S4 shutdown
needs_attention.summary: Item 10267 tapioca delayed at port, won't arrive until 10/6–10/8; S4 will run out around noon today and shut down for level 2 clean until 10/5, wiping Monday's Canada run.
needs_attention.status: Confirmed shutdown plan at 08:13 — line stopping ~noon, level 2 clean and caustic in kitchen, set up for One Shot on 10/5 (Justin Garner). Canada postponed.

needs_attention.title: S4 caramel supply interruptions
needs_attention.summary: Kitchen unable to keep pace with line speed — caramel ran out at 07:22 due to cold tapioca ingredient, again at 08:02 with only 11% in reserve and batches not ready.
needs_attention.status: Multiple pauses for caramel catch-up; 33-minute stop at 08:02, kitchen batching behind demand (Katya Farnsworth).

needs_attention.title: S3 C1 kettle caustic drain valve not opening
needs_attention.summary: Operator opened/closed valve to drain caustic during clean but valve is not physically opening; finishing reserve tank product before maintenance can drain at tank and troubleshoot.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance working on it as of 06:05; caustic clean completed by 07:00 but valve repair status unclear.

needs_attention.title: S4 cross conveyor slitter out of position
needs_attention.summary: Slitter out of position and being damaged; operator and maintenance notified to make adjustment — belt was just replaced yesterday.
needs_attention.status: Operator and maintenance notified at 07:51, no follow-up posted on resolution (Mariela Gudino).

needs_attention.title: S1 enrober return pump valve stuck
needs_attention.summary: Valve isn't opening during enrober cleaning; maintenance plugged air line as workaround to allow wash to proceed, sent photo to Jakob for troubleshooting.
needs_attention.status: Workaround in place at 10:38 — air line plugged to close valve manually, wash completed, but underlying valve issue unresolved (Matt Hatch).

needs_attention.title: S3 enrober pressure faults on riser and return pumps
needs_attention.summary: Riser pump and return pump faulting due to high pressure in return pipe; raised riser pump kg/h 2200→2500 and mass cooling temp +0.1 to increase liquid chocolate flow.
needs_attention.status: Adjustments made at 10:43, monitoring return pipe pressure and Russell finex filter (S3 Enrober).

needs_attention.title: S2 suction pump not working
needs_attention.summary: Suction pump failure; maintenance has been notified to troubleshoot and resolve.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 11:21, no update on repair status (Marcos Jimenez with photo).

needs_attention.title: S4 Canada BOM and spec mismatch
needs_attention.summary: Production BOM showing item 21167 (US single piece) but Canada spec calls for 21195; film wrap numbers don't match between documents.
needs_attention.status: Ira confirmed correct item is 21195 at 12:14, but Katya reports BOM still giving same issue at 12:18 (unresolved in system).

needs_attention.title: FFS cross seal jaws recurring issues
needs_attention.summary: Product-between-jaws alarm and double bags recurring for 18 hours; multiple cleaning and adjustment cycles on feeders, timing, and amperage.
needs_attention.status: Dave found bags hanging on punch at 11:40, cleaned ball/punch/cylinder/shaft. Running better, only normal doubles when waiting for product. Issue significantly reduced but monitoring continues.

needs_attention.title: ML2 printer blurry date code
needs_attention.summary: Date printing blurry and missing top print; line down 09:31–10:51 (80 minutes) for multiple print head and nozzle cleanings before resolving.
needs_attention.status: Line back up at 10:51 after cleaning print head and nozzle twice, final startup successful (Alex Mendoza).
